data.name: Brazen
data.detailed_description:
BRAZEN is a fast-paced elemental roguelite FPS inspired by the fluid movement of Warframe, the build variety of Gunfire Reborn, the combo focused gameplay of ZZZ, and the chaotic power scaling of modern action roguelites.

Harness the forces of Fire, Water, Wind, and Lightning to create devastating elemental reactions, discover powerful upgrades, and forge unique builds every run.

Dash through hordes of enemies, master spell synergies, and unleash increasingly destructive combinations as you descend deeper into a world consumed by arcane chaos.

FEATURES

• Elemental Combo System
Combine Fire, Water, Wind, and Lightning to trigger powerful reactions and create devastating combat chains.

• Build-Crafting Roguelite Progression
Choose from a growing pool of upgrades, spells, and enhancements to create different builds every run.

• Fast-Paced Battlemage Combat
Stay mobile, weave abilities together, and maintain momentum as you fight through increasingly dangerous encounters.

• Surge System
Build Surge through combat and spend it strategically to restore mana and health to sustain your offensive pressure.

• Endless Replayability
Experiment with new combinations, optimize powerful builds, and push deeper into increasingly challenging runs.

PLANNED EXPANSIONS

Brazen is actively evolving with plans for additional spell archetypes, enemy factions, bosses, progression systems, game modes, equipment customization, and cooperative multiplayer support.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
